pixel_code.description: TikTok Pixel ID used as the event_source_id for web events. Both platforms derive from destination configuration.

event_name_mapping.description: Maps Segment/RudderStack event names to TikTok standard event names. Both platforms apply similar transformations.
event_name_mapping.custom_events: Non-standard event names are forwarded as custom events using the original event name

email.description: Email address is lowercased and SHA-256 hashed before sending to TikTok for user matching.

phone.transform: SHA-256 hash after removing non-numeric characters (except leading +)
phone.description: Phone number is normalized and SHA-256 hashed before sending to TikTok.

external_id.description: User ID is SHA-256 hashed and sent as external_id for cross-platform user matching.

ttclid.segment_source: Extracted from page URL query parameter 'ttclid' or context.integrations.TikTok.ttclid
ttclid.rudderstack_source: Extracted from page URL query parameter 'ttclid' or context.integrations.TikTok.ttclid
ttclid.description: TikTok Click ID is extracted from the landing page URL and forwarded for ad attribution.

ttp.description: TikTok browser pixel cookie identifier used for cross-channel user matching.

ip_address.description: Client IP address forwarded for geo-targeting and user matching.

user_agent.description: Browser user agent string forwarded for device identification.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code for monetary events.

value.description: Monetary value of the event. Segment and RudderStack both map revenue/value/total to TikTok value.

contents.description: Product array mapped from Segment spec products to TikTok contents format.

description.description: Description of the item or page.

query.description: Search query string for Search events.

event_id.description: Used for event deduplication between pixel and server-side events. Both platforms use messageId.

timestamp.description: Event timestamp in ISO 8601 format. TikTok accepts ISO 8601 or yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss:SSSZ.

event_source.segment_source: Defaults to 'web'; configurable per destination settings
event_source.rudderstack_source: Defaults to 'web'; configurable per destination settings
event_source.description: Supported values: web, app, offline, crm. Determines the event channel type.

page_url.description: Page URL where the event occurred.

known_differences.description: Segment uses 'analytics.js'; RudderStack uses 'rudder-sdk-js'. This field is in the input event and does not affect the TikTok output payload.
known_differences.impact: No impact — library metadata is not forwarded to TikTok.

known_differences.description: RudderStack input events include additional fields: rudderId, originalTimestamp, sentAt, receivedAt. These are RudderStack-specific envelope fields not present in Segment events.
known_differences.impact: No impact — these envelope fields are not forwarded to TikTok.

known_differences.description: Segment and RudderStack generate messageId values using different UUID strategies. Both are used as event_id for TikTok deduplication.
known_differences.impact: Minimal — only affects deduplication key format, not functionality.

known_differences.description: Both platforms extract ttclid from the page URL query parameter. Verify that URL parsing logic handles edge cases identically (encoded characters, missing parameter).
known_differences.impact: Could affect ad attribution if extraction logic differs.

known_differences.description: Both platforms should SHA-256 hash email, phone, and external_id. Verify that lowercasing and normalization steps are identical (e.g., phone number stripping of spaces/dashes).
known_differences.impact: Different hashing inputs produce different hashes, affecting TikTok user matching rates.

known_differences.description: Verify that the Transformer service maps Segment spec event names (e.g., 'Order Completed') to TikTok standard events (e.g., 'CompletePayment') identically between Segment and RudderStack.
known_differences.impact: Different event name mappings would cause events to be categorized differently in TikTok Ads Manager.

validation_requirements: Verify pixel_code / event_source_id is correctly derived from destination config
Verify all standard event name mappings match Segment's TikTok destination
Verify PII fields (email, phone, external_id) are SHA-256 hashed with identical normalization
Verify ttclid extraction from URL query parameters matches Segment behavior
Verify ttp cookie value forwarding matches Segment behavior
Verify contents[] array mapping from products[] is field-for-field identical
Verify event_id deduplication uses messageId consistently
Verify timestamp format is accepted by TikTok (ISO 8601)
Verify custom (non-standard) events are forwarded with original event name

notes: TikTok is a shared cloud destination in the Advertising category. Segment has an Actions-based variant (actions-tiktok-pixel) in addition to the classic integration. RudderStack delivers TikTok via the Router as a cloud REST destination. The TikTok Events API v1.3 endpoint requires pixel_code (event_source_id) and access_token for authentication. User data (email, phone, external_id) must be SHA-256 hashed before transmission. TikTok supports event deduplication via event_id matching between pixel and server-side events. Key parity focus areas: event name mapping consistency, PII normalization and hashing, ttclid/ttp forwarding, and contents/products array field mapping.
